messages:
morgan: Quick perf note — ran attention kernel sweep on A100-80GB single node for long contexts (8k/16k warmups). Comparing FlashAttention-v2 (patched), our paged-attn, and vendor fused-attn. Early results look noisy and there may be a regression.

morgan: Summary numbers (llama-2-70b-like, batch=1):
```
Baseline (matmul-opt naive attn):       380 tokens/s, p95=42ms
FlashAttention-v2 (patched):            520 tokens/s, p95=30ms
Paged-attn (paged KV cache):            470 tokens/s, p95=34ms
Fused-attn (vendor blob):               300 tokens/s, p95=55ms  <-- regression
```

sachin: saw same in my 2-node run. Once KV size > ~10-12k entries the eviction path causes memcpy stalls. Can you attach profiler dumps? :eyes:

morgan: uploaded flamegraphs + nvprof timeline to artifacts: https://artifacts.redwood/attn/1760003456 (perf.svg, nvprof.csv, paged_hist.txt). Hotspots: kv_store::copy_range and fused_attn::compute.

alejandra: repro command used:
```
./bench --model=llama-2-70b --backend=cuda --kernels=all --seq=8192 --batch=1 --iters=100
```
I rebuilt FlashAttention after upstream commit f2a8c3 (CUDA 12.2); throughput improved but memory pressure rose slightly.

frank: vendor changelog shows they removed a custom fp16 packing path in their fused kernel (see vendor.ai/releases/2026-03-06). That likely explains the drop.

morgan: we need to track three upstreams: FlashAttention repo (recent PRs), vLLM kv-layout PRs (412/418?), and xFormers causal-mask fixes.

sachin: I'll open an internal regression issue linking artifacts and CI failure, and add a controlled matrix harness (kernels x seq-len x KV-size). Will include snabb/pprof snapshots and a tiny reproducer. Target: EOD for issue + harness landing tomorrow.

ci-bot: perf-ci detected regression on branch main for job perf/attn-nightly — median throughput down 18% vs baseline. Job: https://ci.redwood/job/perf/1760003456 (nvprof.log attached)

alejandra: note: our paged-attn reduces memcpy spikes by async prefetching next page, but current impl uses a pinned buffer per-RNG which exhausts pinned memory at scale. Plan: convert to shared page pool.

morgan: action items:
- sachin: open regression issue + add matrix harness (EOD)
- alejandra: prototype shared page pool (next week)
- frank: confirm vendor kernel version & request fallback knobs
- eng-sre + perf: re-run nightly on CUDA 12.2 images (suspect driver mismatch)

olivia: scheduling 30m sync tomorrow 09:30 PT to triage. please include eng-sre and eng-runtime.

morgan: agenda for sync: reproduce, isolate KV vs compute impact, enumerate upstream PRs (FlashAttention, vLLM, xFormers), vendor follow-up, and attach perf test IDs in regression ticket. I'll bisect FlashAttention PRs today and post findings. :shipit:
